lead: A crate added to a built-in component under `extensions/` fails `nv selftest`
body: until `bun nv gen-attribution` rewrites `THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt`, because `tools/nv/test/attribution-extensions.test.ts` checks the notice against the component's `wasm32-wasip2` graph. Run it right after the lockfile changes, before `bun nv verify`. A licence it names as having no policy is a question for the user, unless the crate is outside that graph.
